overview_description.description:
Spruce thinks of a better way to see the doctor by using their platform for communication. 

They think getting great health care in America involves too much waiting and hassle and healthcare pricing should be affordable and involve no surprises. They think the experience of “going to the doctor” can be dramatically improved for both patients and physicians through software to enrich the patient-physician relationship and improve quality, safety, and satisfaction.

They’re committed to building quality healthcare experiences that are accessible anytime, anywhere.

product.name: Spruce Healthcare Communication Platform
product.description: A HIPAA-compliant platform that consolidates messaging, phone, fax, video, and team collaboration for healthcare providers and patients.

product.name: Spruce Video Visits
product.description: A secure video calling service enabling virtual healthcare visits from any location.

product.name: Spruce Secure Messaging
product.description: A HIPAA-compliant messaging system for sending texts, files, and audio notes between healthcare providers and patients.

product.name: Spruce Professional Phone System
product.description: A VoIP phone system tailored for healthcare, offering phone lines, voicemail transcription, call routing, and phone trees.

product.name: Spruce E-Fax
product.description: A service to send and receive electronic faxes securely from phone or web interfaces.

product.name: Spruce Clinical Questionnaires
product.description: Digital questionnaires used to screen patients in advance of appointments.
